responses:
I reviewed the analysis against the tender. **Do not send the offer as it stands.** The 20-week delivery breaks a clause that leads to automatic rejection, and the analysis checks only 2 of the tender's 10 requirements.

## Findings

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | "Delivery: 20 weeks from PO. Complies with 7.4." | tender.md §7.4: *"within 16 weeks of purchase order. Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected."* | APPLIES | Section 9 (which overrides 4 and 7 per §9.3) has no delivery clause, so 7.4 stands | **CONTRADICTED.** 20 weeks is over the 16-week limit, and §7.4 says such offers are rejected. |
| 2 | "Enclosures: IP66 offered vs IP65 required. Complies." | tender.md §4.5: *"IP65 or better"* | APPLIES to panel and motor terminal enclosures | Nothing in Section 9 overrides it | **VERIFIED.** IP66 has the same dust rating (6) and better water protection (powerful jets instead of jets), so it is "better". |

**Counts:** 1 VERIFIED, 1 CONTRADICTED, 0 UNSUPPORTED, 0 NEEDS HUMAN.

## Requirements the analysis missed

| Clause | Requirement | Applies to | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| §4.1 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz | All equipment | Not checked. |
| §4.2 + **§9.1** | IE3 minimum, but **IE4 for pump motors above 75 kW** | P-01 (90 kW) → **IE4**; P-02 (37 kW) → IE3 | §9.1 overrides §4.2 because §9.3 gives Section 9 precedence. If the offer assumes IE3 everywhere, P-01 fails. |
| §4.3 + Annex B | ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1 | P-01 (wet well = Zone 1) | P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so it doesn't apply there. The P-01 motor must be Ex d certified. |
| §4.4 | Power cable at least 2.5 mm² | All power cabling | Not checked. |
| §7.1 | 24-month warranty **from commissioning**, not from delivery | Offer terms | Not checked. Watch the start date. |
| §9.2 | Ambient design temperature of 50 °C | All equipment | Not checked. Motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so you need to confirm derating or a 50 °C rating for P-01 and P-02, and the thermal design of the panels. |
| §9.3 | Precedence: Section 9 overrides Sections 4 and 7 | Interpretation | The analysis didn't apply it, which is how the IE4 requirement for P-01 was missed. |

## Go / no-go

**NO-GO.** Before this goes out:
1. Get delivery down to 16 weeks or less (§7.4), or get a written deviation accepted by the customer. Otherwise the offer is rejected outright.
2. Check that the P-01 motor is **IE4 and ATEX Ex d**, and that both motors and the panels are rated for **50 °C** ambient.
3. Confirm the supply rating (§4.1), cable size (§4.4) and warranty terms (§7.1) in the offer.
